measurement_rules: Human-reviewed evidence labels are required before reporting semantic quality rates.
Include all expected claims, including unattempted cases, in recall; never count failures as correct empty output.
failed_cases_max refers to the compatibility count of cases with an error code, including blocked cases; report attempted failures and unattempted cases separately using validated execution evidence.
Historical execution without sufficient sidecar evidence remains unknown, not an inferred failure or success.
Null precision/recall denominators or unreviewed labels cannot pass a quality target.
Quantiles are descriptive for this small dataset, not a production latency guarantee.
Record requested and provider-reported model IDs per call; missing observations remain null.
Report available token usage and cost per call; do not invent total cost when observations are missing.
Targets must be approved with a usable baseline before tuning. Then freeze prompt/configuration before the fixed holdout run.
notes: Draft targets for review, not a team decision or achieved model score. The current unavailable Gemma run is not a usable accuracy baseline. No prompt tuning or new holdout evaluation has begun.
